scope: P0 is an original, offline-capable 2D single-player fantasy RPG delivered through a shared web core and a PWA delivery adaptation. Connected services are not P0 implementation scope.

first_bounded_domain.title: Foundation and core contracts
first_bounded_domain.boundary: Framework-neutral seams, deterministic state/data contracts, local persistence protocol, quality foundations, and original-design controls; excludes campaign rules, UI flows, PWA lifecycle, and release execution.

contracts.title: Bootstrap reproducible shared project baseline
contracts.bounded_outcome: A framework-neutral project skeleton documents one bootstrap, lint, format, and deterministic test command with isolated shared, web-adapter, PWA-adapter, content, and test directories.
contracts.verification: Clean approved-runtime checkout runs the documented deterministic sample test, lint, and format checks.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0001 / DEC-0001 framework, package-manager, and CI selection before implementation.

contracts.title: Enforce shared-core and adapter dependency seams
contracts.bounded_outcome: A dependency policy and public interfaces prevent core code from importing browser, renderer, clock, network, or platform modules; adapters submit commands and render returned state/events.

api: Command, state, event, and adapter interfaces

contracts.verification: A dependency-rule test rejects forbidden core imports and a fixture adapter proves command-only interaction.
contracts.human_external_gate: None; retain GATE-0001 for tool-specific enforcement.

contracts.title: Create deterministic test and fixture harness
contracts.bounded_outcome: Layered unit, content, integration, and reserved browser-test conventions provide isolated RNG/clock and persistence fixtures with no real service or player data access.

api: test fixture and fake clock/RNG interfaces

contracts.verification: Repeated core fixture execution has identical results; a deliberately failing fixture is detected; fixture storage is isolated.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002 before compatibility or performance claims.

contracts.title: Define deterministic campaign state and command contract
contracts.bounded_outcome: Immutable versioned state, command/result/event envelopes, revision and interaction identifiers, deterministic RNG state, and invariant helpers define legal transition mechanics without feature state machines.
contracts.verification: Invalid and stale commands do not mutate state; duplicate interaction IDs cause no extra durable transition.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 before concrete party/content shapes.

contracts.title: Define versioned content schema and validation boundary
contracts.bounded_outcome: Typed content-package schema and validator cover IDs, references, locale keys, assets, predicates, rewards, and reachability but contain no authored campaign expression.
contracts.verification: Valid minimum package passes; each invalid reference class fails; a graph fixture checks opening-to-ending reachability.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 for quantities, locale, and content detail; human provenance review remains required.

contracts.title: Specify local save and recovery protocol
contracts.bounded_outcome: A schema protocol specifies immutable revisions, checksums, current-pointer validation, known-good retention, quarantine, separate preferences, deletion confirmation, and safe-boundary persistence rules.
contracts.verification: Fault fixtures cover interrupted write, checksum failure, malformed data, quota/permission failure, quarantine, retry, and selected-slot deletion.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0003 / DEC-0003 storage API, quota, support window, and recovery policy.

contracts.title: Define pure save migration runner
contracts.bounded_outcome: Ordered, pure migrations declare supported versions and promote only validated candidates while preserving original invalid bytes for quarantine.
contracts.verification: Every declared predecessor migrates once; unsupported or failed migration leaves the original candidate intact and quarantined.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0003 / DEC-0003 support-window approval.

contracts.title: Bound P0 identity, authorization, and connected-service exclusions
contracts.bounded_outcome: Architecture and negative contract tests demonstrate that local campaign start/save/resume require no account identifier, token, remote profile, role, entitlement, multiplayer, or safety service.
contracts.verification: Static scan and negative fixtures find no identity/token/privilege fields or network client in P0 foundation modules.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0006 / DEC-0006 before any connected implementation.

contracts.title: Define privacy-safe local diagnostics boundary
contracts.bounded_outcome: A bounded local diagnostic schema, consent and clear controls, redaction rules, and no-network guardrails support future player recovery without collecting save or dialogue payloads.
contracts.verification: Tests prove diagnostics are absent without consent, redact payloads, and can be deleted locally.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0005 / DEC-0005 before transport, retention, hosting, or support claims.

contracts.title: Establish semantic accessibility design tokens
contracts.bounded_outcome: Original semantic tokens cover typography, spacing, focus, motion, touch targets, status, contrast, and non-colour cues, enabling later responsive web UI and inherited PWA UI.
contracts.verification: Token validation proves semantic labels/non-colour cues and reduced-motion values in representative fixtures.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002 and GATE-0004 before numeric contrast/font/breakpoint claims.

contracts.title: Create original-content provenance control
contracts.bounded_outcome: A provenance record format, review checklist, and source-asset manifest make authorship and permitted functional reference scope auditable before authored content enters a build.
contracts.verification: Validator rejects missing provenance fields; human creative review is recorded for each authored package.
contracts.human_external_gate: Human creative/provenance review; legal or licensing review if applicable under GATE-0007.

contracts.title: Document foundation architecture and recovery boundaries
contracts.bounded_outcome: Developer documentation records ownership, command flow, save-versus-cache separation, deferred connected scope, and the decisions/gates that later domain authors must preserve.
forbidden_scope: claiming approved vendor or policy choices
contracts.verification: Documentation review cross-checks every foundation contract's ownership, dependency, and gate against this catalogue.
contracts.human_external_gate: None; approval gates are documented, not resolved.

contracts.title: Define exploration scene and exit transition contract
contracts.bounded_outcome: Content-neutral scene, exit, collision, and interaction transitions preserve a completable route without UI ownership.
contracts.verification: Invalid exits and references leave state unchanged; a route graph is validated.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 before concrete content shapes.

contracts.title: Define narrative quest and tutorial state transitions
contracts.bounded_outcome: Original-content-neutral dialogue, quest, tutorial, and campaign state rules make required progression explicit and idempotent.
contracts.verification: Repeated completion and invalid predicates are rejected safely.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 before authored text, locale, and content detail.

contracts.title: Define deterministic encounter and reward resolution contract
contracts.bounded_outcome: A deterministic encounter, legal-action, defeat, and one-time reward contract supports the first battle without values or presentation.
contracts.verification: Invalid actions do not mutate and reward IDs grant once.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 before concrete party, enemy, and balance shapes.

contracts.title: Define safe inventory and party progression contract
contracts.bounded_outcome: Eligibility-checked inventory, party progression, and stable reward application protect required items and avoid dead ends.
contracts.verification: Ineligible use and duplicate rewards are no-ops.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 before authored item/progression shapes.

contracts.title: Specify campaign progression and safe ending integration
contracts.bounded_outcome: One town-to-dungeon-to-ending progression integration specifies safe checkpoints and a completable original campaign route.
contracts.verification: Reachability proves one route and ending is idempotent.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 before authored campaign implementation.

contracts.title: Define original campaign content-package and provenance assembly
contracts.bounded_outcome: A versioned package assembles the one-town/one-dungeon campaign using original assets and auditable provenance, without creating those assets in authoring.
contracts.verification: Validator resolves references and rejects absent provenance.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 and human creative/provenance review before implementation.

contracts.title: Add campaign domain invariant and negative-fixture coverage
contracts.bounded_outcome: Deterministic fixtures cover invalid campaign references, blocked routes, stale commands, and duplicate grants across SHARD-02.
contracts.verification: Every fixture is deterministic and each invalid case is detected.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0004 retained for concrete content assumptions.

contracts.title: Document SHARD-02 ownership, gates, and handoff boundaries
contracts.bounded_outcome: Developer documentation records campaign-domain ownership, explicit gates, asset/provenance handoff, and the UI/PWA boundary for SHARD-03.
contracts.verification: Review cross-checks all SHARD-02 contracts and retained gates.
contracts.human_external_gate: None; documents GATE-0004 and provenance review without resolving either.

contracts.title: Define shared session and safe checkpoint presentation model
contracts.bounded_outcome: A framework-neutral session model covers launch, title, new-or-resume, play, pause, ending, focus loss, and confirmed checkpoint state without owning persistence drivers or platform layout.
contracts.verification: Deterministic tests prove focus loss pauses safely and unconfirmed saves never present as confirmed.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0003 and GATE-0004 remain implementation gates for storage and concrete campaign assumptions.

contracts.title: Define semantic responsive game-shell and navigation contract
contracts.bounded_outcome: A semantic shell specifies title, main controls, status, panels, dialogs, visible focus, reflow, and non-colour cues around the shared game state without a PWA-specific UI fork.
contracts.verification: Representative fixtures retain labelled controls and legal focus order through resize and panel changes.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002 and GATE-0004 remain explicit for numeric thresholds and final content/layout choices.

contracts.title: Map semantic actions across keyboard, pointer, touch, and gamepad
contracts.bounded_outcome: One action vocabulary maps movement, inspect, confirm, cancel, pause, panels, and legal combat choices across supported inputs with safe repeat and disconnect handling.
contracts.verification: Fixtures prove equivalent semantic actions, no duplicate destructive confirmation, and usable fallback after gamepad disconnect.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002 remains for approved browser/device compatibility claims.

contracts.title: Specify accessible settings, captions, and feedback preferences
contracts.bounded_outcome: Settings and feedback contracts cover text, contrast, motion, caption visibility, audio controls, preference failure, and reset confirmation while retaining unapproved audio and localisation scope.

data: local preference model and caption state

contracts.verification: Tests cover reduced motion, non-colour state text, preference-write failure, and reset isolation from campaign saves.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002, GATE-0003, and GATE-0004 remain explicit implementation and release gates.

contracts.title: Define recoverable empty, error, and destructive UI states
contracts.bounded_outcome: Bounded UI state contracts explain empty content, invalid actions, save failure, recovery, diagnostics, and selected-slot deletion with focus-safe confirmation.
contracts.verification: Fixtures prove destructive actions start on Cancel, invalid actions preserve state, and recovery exposes legal next actions.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0003 and GATE-0005 remain explicit for storage policy and diagnostics transport.

contracts.title: Add SHARD-03 accessibility and input integration evidence
contracts.bounded_outcome: Deterministic contract fixtures cross-check session, shell, input, settings, and recovery boundaries while reserving browser/device matrix evidence for the approved release gate.
contracts.verification: Structural review finds every SHARD-03 contract covered once and preserves all retained gates.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002, GATE-0003, and GATE-0004 remain unresolved.

contracts.title: Define PWA manifest and install eligibility boundary
contracts.bounded_outcome: A manifest and install-readiness contract identifies original public metadata, icons as reserved assets, and explicit unsupported-state behaviour without claiming browser support or store distribution.
contracts.verification: Schema and negative fixtures reject incomplete manifest data and represent unavailable installation safely.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002 and GATE-0007 remain for browser matrix and original visual assets.

contracts.title: Specify safe service-worker cache, update, and offline recovery lifecycle
contracts.bounded_outcome: A service-worker lifecycle keeps immutable release cache separate from saves, applies updates only at a safe session boundary, and retains a known-good cache after refresh failure.

api: safe update and offline status API

contracts.verification: Fixtures cover offline launch, failed refresh, cache eviction boundary, and confirmed-save update timing.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002 and GATE-0005 remain for browser/storage policy and security review.

contracts.title: Define release configuration, artifact integrity, and local diagnostics checks
contracts.bounded_outcome: Bounded release checks validate public configuration, artifact provenance, secret exclusion, local diagnostic redaction, and a candidate evidence record without contacting a host.
contracts.verification: Positive and malformed configuration fixtures, artifact scan fixtures, and redaction checks are deterministic.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0005 and GATE-0007 remain for policy, security, and provenance review.

contracts.title: Specify performance and compatibility evidence collection boundary
contracts.bounded_outcome: A repeatable evidence harness records candidate, environment, method, result, and exceptions while refusing pass claims without approved budgets and device/browser matrix.
contracts.verification: Schema fixtures reject incomplete evidence and label unapproved matrix/budget checks not run.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002 and GATE-0005 remain for approved targets, budgets, and policy.

contracts.title: Document player recovery and operator release/rollback boundary
contracts.bounded_outcome: Player and operator documentation describes local save/cache separation, update recovery, rollback holds, privacy controls, and evidence responsibilities without asserting a release occurred.
contracts.verification: Cross-check review maps every recovery and release claim to a contract or marks it not run.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0005 and GATE-0007 remain explicit for policy and release authority.

contracts.title: Create final PWA/release evidence hold audit
contracts.bounded_outcome: A final contract audit assembles implementation evidence requirements and records all unapproved release, browser, security, and provenance gates as holds rather than release approval.
contracts.verification: Audit fixtures require every evidence row to be pass, fail, blocked, or not run with source and owner.
contracts.human_external_gate: GATE-0002, GATE-0005, and GATE-0007 remain unresolved and block release claims.

expansion_queue.title: Campaign content and domain logic
expansion_queue.target_allocation: shared core and content only; no UI ownership

expansion_queue.title: Session, UI, input, and accessibility
expansion_queue.target_allocation: shared UI model; web input/layout adapter; PWA inherits UI with no separate UI fork

expansion_queue.title: PWA delivery, performance, operations, and release evidence
expansion_queue.target_allocation: web release build and PWA service-worker/install adapter are distinct; shared core owns neither cache nor hosting

expansion_queue.title: Connected-scope decision package
expansion_queue.target_allocation: no P0 target implementation; research/decision outputs only if explicitly authorised
